description: Gets one feedback request with its full context: page URL, the clicked element (CSS selector, tag, nearby text, position), device and viewport, screenshot and photo URLs, and the thread. Use it before changing code for a request. Text changes (type text_change) give the current and the exact new wording; they can usually be applied directly in the code (search the project for currentText). If a request is ambiguous, reply_to_feedback asking the client to clarify instead of guessing. Screenshot and photo URLs are temporary; fetch them to look.
name: get_feedback
title: Get client feedback
